dictionary.lore: There was a young maiden who raised the God Flag. She followed the practice of this god and fought anyone who opposed him. When the god exercised his power, she would wave the banner as well. It is said that when she did so, the god would recover all of his power in one shot. Her hair and armor were decorated with incredibly beautiful flowers that no human had ever seen before, and which never withered.
